summary: The diff adds substantial backend and frontend scaffolding for a transparent parental control dashboard (roles, child-submitted activity/location, content filter policy UI, alerts UI, admin account disable/enable UI, and audit log UI). However, several acceptance-criteria details are not evidenced or appear partially implemented (notably: location place-name capture, filter metadata transparency, alert acknowledgment + “request more time” delivery, and audit-log immutability guarantees). A couple of unrequested product/branding behaviors are also introduced (e.g., “Built with caffeine.ai” footer).

missing_requirements.requirement: Child location entry should support a textual place name and/or coordinates, with explicit consent per submission.
missing_requirements.reason: ChildCheckIn collects a `locationPlace` field but does not send it to the backend mutation; backend `LocationEntry` type contains only latitude/longitude/timestamp/childId, so a textual place name is not represented or persisted based on shown code.

missing_requirements.requirement: Child can view the current content filter policy in read-only mode including last-updated timestamp and who updated it.
missing_requirements.reason: The read-only component displays categories/allowlist/blocklist, but no “last updated” timestamp or “updated by”/actor field is shown, and the backend `ContentFilterConfig` type shown contains no metadata fields to support that transparency requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Parent dashboard shows alerts and allows marking them as acknowledged; child can submit a 'request more time' note to parent.
missing_requirements.reason: Alerts panels compute over-limit locally from activities and schedule, but there is no evidence of an acknowledged state/endpoint. The child “request more time” action explicitly states backend support is needed and only saves locally, so it is not delivered to the parent via backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an immutable audit log in the backend for sensitive actions.
missing_requirements.reason: An `auditLogs` map of lists is present, but the diff does not evidence append-only enforcement/immutability protections (e.g., no visible prevention of deletion or modification of existing entries).

hallucinated_features.description: Footer includes third-party promotional link/attribution to caffeine.ai ('Built with … using caffeine.ai').
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement; introduces unrelated branding/marketing behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Dark mode/theme toggle via next-themes in the header.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested in requirements (theme consistency is requested, but a dark-mode toggle is an additional unasked feature).
